description: MainActivity class for an Android Wearable app that manages notifications and user interactions via a list view, including handling remote input replies.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for handling wearable notifications and user interactions.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Inner class adapter for displaying notification presets in a WearableListView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and configures the list view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles remote input replies when activity resumes.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification based on selected preset.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items to update notifications.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Empty handler for clicks on empty list regions.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder for list items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to list item views.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns number of items in the list.
